verdict.rationale: Rev AI is an API-first service. Its documented Asynchronous Speech-to-Text API, command-line requests, SDKs and webhook completion notifications let it run without a UI in automated pipelines. Nothing in the pack covers CI use specifically or a dedicated CLI or automation tooling. Missing for 10: a dedicated headless CLI, CI/CD integration docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
